text: dsh-external-task-context 是面向 DSH Web 会话视图的外部子任务上下文插件。它把会话中已有的委派调用、外部子任务目录和完成消息折叠为会话投影，并在会话视图标签中呈现提示词、运行状态和返回结果。Claude Code 任务还可查看流式运行日志，并统计耗时、消息数、工具调用、token 用量与成本；Codex 和 ACP 可查看委派上下文与结果。适合需要回看外部 Agent 执行情况的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥。

dsh-external-task-context adds an external-task view to DSH Web sessions. It shows delegated prompts, task status, and returned results from session events. For Claude Code, it also displays streamed logs and summaries of duration, messages, tool calls, tokens, and cost. No API key is required.

dsh-external-task-context 的功能「外部任务会话视图」：在 DSH 会话标题的视图标签行打开“外部任务”，查看委派提示词、任务状态和完成结果；有多个任务时可切换选择。
dsh-external-task-context 的功能「Claude Code 日志与统计」：任务运行中逐步读取并显示日志；统计视图汇总耗时、消息数、工具调用和结果数、输入输出 token 与成本。

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · External Task Context (dsh-external-task-context)：Inspect the delegation prompt, runtime context, and returned outcome of external subagent tasks (Claude Code, Codex, ACP) in a dedicated conversation view tab of the DSH Web app.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Features and location：- **Conversation view tab**: the plugin registers the `external-task` entry in the session header's View tab row (`Conversation / Traces / Context / Orchestration / Statistics / …`, labeled "External tasks"). Selecting it renders the plugin inside the session body; there is no global panel or header button.
- **Toolbar**: shows the active task's status, tool, and start time. When more than one task exists, a task selector switches between them; the newest task is selected by default, an explicit selection is kept while it exists, and a task that disappears falls back to the newest. Two chips, `Conversation / Statistics`, switch the body.
- **Conversation**: one streamed, Markdown-rendered conversation. The delegation prompt is the right-aligned user bubble (with a metadata line above it) in a fixed 240px-high box that scrolls internally for long prompts. For Claude Code tasks, the live DSH run log is appended below it while the task executes, and the returned content or settlement summary is appended last once the task settles.
- **Log blocks**: assistant prose renders open; thinking, tool calls, and tool results ar
@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Data sources：Everything shown is already recorded in the **parent session log**; the plugin adds no session event and changes no model-visible behavior:
@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Data sources：The host folds those events into the `externalTaskContexts` projection; the client only reads that projection.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Run logs (Claude Code only)：While a Claude Code task runs, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-claude-code` writes its execution log at `<DSH_HOME>/logs/subagent-claude-code/<runId>.jsonl` — one JSON record per line: `start`, every raw SDK message, then `end`. `runId` is the task's catalog `childId`.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Run logs (Claude Code only)：The plugin reads it through its authenticated Fetch route `GET /api/external-task-context/log?childId=…&source=dsh&offset=…`, which returns only complete newline-terminated UTF-8 lines so the viewer can tail a growing file. The client polls once a second while the task is pending and stops when it settles. Claude Code's native transcript is not fetched or shown.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Run logs (Claude Code only)：Logs are written with mode `0600` in a `0700` directory and are pruned after 7 days by default. Older tasks recorded before this feature have no log.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Known limitations：External providers (Claude Code, Codex, ACP) run out of process; DSH does not persist their internal steps or tool-call records. Run logs are implemented for the Claude Code provider only; Codex and ACP tasks show the delegation context and returned outcome without a live log.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Installation：Requires DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` or newer and Node `^22.19 || >=24`. Live run logs need a provider with run-log support: the official `0.2.2-rc.1` enables it through the patch package in `patch/`; master builds include it.

text:
@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Usage：1. Ask the model to delegate work through an external subagent tool (Claude Code, Codex, or ACP).
2. Open the "External tasks" tab in the session header's View tab row.
3. Read the delegation prompt, the streamed run log, and the returned outcome under `Conversation`. For Claude Code tasks, use `Statistics` for aggregate counters.
4. Use the task selector when the session recorded several tasks; switch back to another View tab to return to the chat.

@lifenrir/dsh-external-task-context README · Privacy：The projection is persisted with the session projection cache, so prompts and returned content are stored a second time outside the session log (the content already exists in the session log). Treat them with the same sensitivity in shared environments or when exporting a session.
